description: A128KW on a set whose only oct key has key_ops [sign, verify] fails with NoMatchingKey; decided by ADR 0054 §2.4 (key_ops): with an alg and no key_op, key_ops must hold an operation A128KW performs in either direction (wrapKey or unwrapKey), and [sign, verify] holds neither, so zero members match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
